name: sitting lower trunk extensor stretch
description: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
